_comment: 视觉风格（look）—— 纯 prompt，**禁止**出现 track / narrative / delivery_stop / narration_* 字段。一条 look 可被任意 track 引用；轨道内的「渲染流」在 tracks.json.render_styles，两者拼装使用。
compose: style_prompt = look.prompt ｜ track.render_styles[key].prompt（真人轨无渲染流，只用 look）

looks.name: 电影超现实
looks.prompt: surreal live-action film look, impossible spatial logic, symbolic visual logic, dreamlike continuity, poetic composition, unexpected juxtaposition, restrained but uncanny color, soft haze, philosophical mood, visually intelligent absurdity, cinematic art-house surrealism, no fantasy spectacle overload.

looks.name: 电影超写实
looks.prompt: 真人电影写实摄影，原生相机直出，无 AI 塑料感，自然真实皮肤肌理，原生环境光影，柔和自然明暗，丁达尔效应，真实景深虚化，细腻原生材质，轻微自然噪点，真人实拍质感，色彩自然还原

looks.name: 拉美魔幻现实
looks.prompt: Latin American magical-realist live-action look, vivid yet grounded color, poetic domestic atmosphere, warm humid light, textured everyday surfaces, subtle impossible details woven into ordinary life, calm characters accepting the strange as normal, family-memory feeling, grounded surreal warmth, no fantasy spectacle or heavy VFX.

looks.name: 日式青春胶片
looks.prompt: 日式青春胶片：强调胶片颗粒、年代色偏、生活化场景、旧广告牌、钨丝灯、街头烟火气和真实抓拍感，画面应有怀旧质感、轻微褪色、柔和动态模糊和时代记忆。核心描述：日式青春胶片，适合角色资产生成、风格化提示词和短片视觉统一。色彩关键词：胶片暖黄、褪色绿色、钨丝灯橙、旧照片灰调。光影关键词：自然窗光、钨丝灯、街灯反射、轻微过曝。镜头关键词：胶片抓拍、生活化中景、轻颗粒、纪实构图。环境关键词：旧街道、霓虹招牌、老式室内、年代道具。生成时必须把这些风格特征落实到角色造型、服装材质、神态动作、背景空间和整体画面气质中，而不是只写风格名称。

looks.name: 短剧风格
looks.prompt: contemporary short-form drama live-action look, high-emotion performance, direct dramatic tension, bright but dramatic lighting, strong facial expression, simplified but believable production design, heightened emotional readability, glossy contemporary color, fast-recognizable drama atmosphere, no platform UI, no captions, no subtitles, no title cards, no poster layout.

looks.name: 日式赛璐璐
looks.prompt: 日式赛璐璐，正统日系清新动画，干净利落线条，均匀自然平涂，柔和明暗分界，简约治愈日系美学，画面干净通透无 AI 糊感

looks.name: 国漫二次元常用风格
looks.prompt: 国漫二次元常用风格：强调角色设计感、线条节奏、色块关系、夸张轮廓、情绪化光影和插画构图，画面应有清晰主次、强记忆点和适合二创传播的视觉符号。核心描述：国漫二次元常用风格，适合角色资产生成、风格化提示词和短片视觉统一。色彩关键词：高识别主色、干净色块、情绪化渐变、角色专属配色。光影关键词：插画式主光、轮廓高光、情绪阴影、局部强调光。镜头关键词：角色海报构图、动态姿态、强剪影、视觉中心明确。环境关键词：风格化背景、符号化场景、图形化装饰、叙事道具。生成时必须把这些风格特征落实到角色造型、服装材质、神态动作、背景空间和整体画面气质中，而不是只写风格名称。

looks.name: 国漫仙侠
looks.prompt: Chinese xianxia fantasy, cultivation world, floating mountains, flowing robes, jade and bronze ornaments, mist and golden runes, mythic scale

looks.name: 都市豪门
looks.prompt: contemporary urban drama, old-money interiors, floor-to-ceiling glass, tailored dark suits, restrained warm practicals, muted wealth palette

looks.name: 悬疑暗调
looks.prompt: neo-noir suspense, hard side light, deep shadows, wet asphalt reflections, desaturated palette with one cold accent, clinical tension

looks.name: 日系恋爱
looks.prompt: Japanese romance anime look, soft bloom, pastel skies, delicate line art, gentle rim light, intimate two-shot framing

looks.name: 国漫搞笑
looks.prompt: Chinese webtoon comedy, exaggerated expressions, bold flat colors, punchy contrast, wide reaction shots, playful timing

looks.name: 水墨二维
looks.prompt: Chinese ink-wash animation, sumi-e brush strokes, negative space, restrained monochrome with a single vermilion accent, poetic stillness
